visuals.classification_reason: Required to evaluate this specific evidence: The image activation module supplies a preliminary reference. Both images are encoded, and weight-shared ControlNet extracts their features. The U-Net receives feature additions plus multiple attention in its upsampling blocks. Reference attention encourages detailed reconstruction; original-image attention is intended to correct reference artifacts. Frozen and trainable symbols identify what is optimized. The architecture provides an opportunity to correct errors, not a mathematical projection onto the true image.

visuals.classification_reason: Required to evaluate this specific evidence: On DIV2K, CasSR gives MUSIQ 68.6242 and MANIQA 0.4927. The next-best listed values are DiffBIR’s 67.0657 and 0.4580, so table-derived relative gains are about 2.32% and 7.58%, not the prose’s 3.82% and 7.05%. CasSR’s LPIPS 0.3225 trails SeeSR 0.3050 and HAT 0.3175; NIQE 3.6026 trails DiffBIR 2.9574. Thus “best or second best across all metrics” is too broad. On RealSR, LPIPS worsens to 0.3822 versus SeeSR 0.3034, despite MUSIQ improving 69.7639→70.4224. These rows support a perceptual-quality trade-off, not general fidelity superiority.
